verdict.rationale: The integrations directory lists first-party Datadog, Grafana and Sentry integrations, and the product claims over 40 ready-made alert sources configurable from observability tools. Prometheus and CloudWatch are never named, and the evidence offers only directory blurbs, not setup guides. missing for 10: evidence of Prometheus and CloudWatch integrations, documented step-by-step setup for each integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, first-party integrations cover my observability stack — Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Sentry — with documented setup

citations.quote: Automatically create incidents from Datadog monitors and stream your audit logs to Datadog SIEM
Use Grafana to attach alerts to incidents.
Link errors to incidents and track them in realtime using our Sentry integration.
We have over 40 alert sources ready to go, plus the ability to roll your own via HTTP.
Alerts: Configure alerts from your observability tools.
